groups.label: Medial end
groups.description: Medial clavicle fracture or sternoclavicular-end injury pattern.

variants.label: Extraarticular medial
variants.description: Medial clavicle fracture without sternoclavicular articular involvement.

variants.label: Articular medial
variants.description: Fracture involving the medial clavicular articular surface.

variants.label: Medial comminution
variants.description: Comminuted medial clavicle fracture or unstable medial segment.

treatments.label: Sling and observation
treatments.main_indications: Most minimally displaced medial clavicle fractures without posterior displacement risk.

treatments.label: Plate fixation principles
treatments.main_indications: Unstable displaced fracture requiring restoration of shoulder girdle stability.

treatments.label: Shoulder suspensory complex reference
treatments.main_indications: Combined clavicle/scapula pattern or suspensory complex instability assessment.

variants.label: Simple
variants.description: Simple transverse, oblique, or spiral mid-shaft fracture.

variants.label: Comminuted
variants.description: Multifragmentary mid-shaft clavicle fracture with shortening risk.

treatments.label: Sling treatment
treatments.main_indications: Minimally displaced fracture, low shortening, and acceptable skin/soft-tissue status.

treatments.label: Plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Displacement, shortening, segmental pattern, skin compromise, or high-demand patient after shared decision-making.

treatments.label: Lag screw adjunct
treatments.main_indications: Long oblique simple pattern where interfragmentary compression is useful with neutralization plate.

groups.label: Lateral end
groups.description: Lateral clavicle fracture patterns related to coracoclavicular ligament stability.

variants.label: Stable lateral
variants.description: Lateral clavicle fracture with preserved coracoclavicular stability.

variants.label: Unstable lateral
variants.description: Lateral clavicle fracture medial to coracoclavicular ligaments or with ligament disruption.

variants.label: Intraarticular lateral
variants.description: Fracture involving the acromioclavicular articular end.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Stable lateral fracture with acceptable displacement.

treatments.label: Lateral locking plate / hook plate principles
treatments.main_indications: Unstable lateral fracture requiring fixation and possible ligament augmentation.

treatments.label: Coracoclavicular reconstruction reference
treatments.main_indications: Associated coracoclavicular ligament disruption or chronic instability pattern.
